entries.title: Psalms 126:1
segments: ¶<A Song of the going up.> When the Lord made a change in Zion's fate, we were like men in a dream.

entries.title: Psalms 126:2
segments: Then our mouths were full of laughing, and our tongues gave a glad cry; they said among the nations, The Lord has done great things for them.

entries.title: Psalms 126:3
segments: The Lord has done great things for us; because of which we are glad.

entries.title: Psalms 126:4
segments: ¶Let our fate be changed, O Lord, like the streams in the South.

entries.title: Psalms 126:5
segments: Those who put in seed with weeping will get in the grain with cries of joy.

entries.title: Psalms 126:6
segments: Though a man may go out weeping, taking his vessel of seed with him; he will come again in joy, with the corded stems of grain in his arms.
